profile.headline: Senior Creative Software Engineer at Envoy
profile.summary: Lucas started his career in 3D animation after graduating from Full Sail University. His technical proficiency in 3D art and motion capture led him to increasingly challenging and technical roles, and eventually Lucas established himself as a full-time software engineer with a focus on 3D art. He later founded Enviral Design, where he created GeoPix, an open-source lighting and previz software, and helped bring visually stunning experiences to brands such as AT&T, Meow Wolf, Spotify, Hennessy, Taylor Swift, Toyota, and Electric Forest. Driven by the interplay of his visual and technical skills, Lucas continually elevates the quality of the projects he works on.

positions.title: Founder & Owner
positions.description:
Created GeoPix , an open source lighting control & previz software made for large-scale
lighting design, stage production, and architectural installation.
- Developed GPU-accelerated infrastructure that delivers 250,000+ pixels worth of real-time content @ 60 fps in a single threaded scenario.
- Architected a workflow that unifies driving video, LED & DMX fixtures with video.
- Built UI system that instantly generates 100+ widgets via HTML/CSS/JS integration.
- Maintenance of 66,000+ lines of Python application code.
- Management of website, marketing, video tutorials, and social communities.

positions.title: Senior Software Developer
positions.description:
Led optimization efforts for Crescent Sun , a video mapping performance software.
- Overhauled the PanelFX system to achieve 200+ panels @ 60 fps.
- Rebuilt back-end subsystems for scalability and reduced memory footprint.
- Optimized panel mapper front-end tool for a more intuitive user experience.

positions.title: Lead Environment Artist
positions.description:
Lead Environment Artist on Adera , built & managed render farm for 8-10x rendering gains.
Responsible for 3D environments, shading, lighting, rendering, compositing.

positions.title: 3D Artist
positions.description: Responsible for 3D environments, shading, lighting, rendering, compositing, motion capture.

positions.title: 3D Artist
positions.description: My primary task at Imedia was to create believable and realistic 3d environments for use as backgrounds to e-learning games.
